validity.researcher_notes: Existence and classification are solid: this segment is one leg of the real, well-documented 'South Valley Gas Pipeline' / 'Upper Egypt Gas Pipeline' transmission trunk (Dahshour-Aswan), inaugurated by President Mubarak Dec 2010, built by Petrojet for Nile Valley Gas Company. Spec check: the sheet's own existing ref (almasryalyoum.com/news/details/103848, Dec 2010 Al-Masry Al-Youm) gives an EXACT phase-by-phase breakdown and explicitly states: 'تصل المرحلة الثانية بين الكريمات وصولا إلى محافظة بني سويف بطول 30 كم وقطر 32 بوصة' - 'the second phase, from Al-Kurimat to Beni Suef governorate, is 30 km long and 32 inches in diameter' - matching GEM's LengthKnown=30km and Diameter=32in exactly, and naming both endpoints verbatim. Status=operating, Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission, StartYear1=2009 are all consistent with this same source and with the gem.wiki page's own segment table (checked for lead purposes only, not cited). This is currently only ONE independent, if strong and highly specific, source for this exact segment (tier=medium per corroboration rules), because the other wiki-cited English sources (Australian Pipeliner Sep-2009, Petroleum Africa - likely re-reporting the same 2009 ministry statement, so not independent of each other) describe the corridor with a coarser, DIFFERENT phase breakdown that lumps 'Cairo to a power station near Beni Suef' as one legacy phase NVGC 'took over' from the government, without isolating a 30km/32in Kurimat-Beni Suef leg - so they neither confirm nor contradict this specific segment. GulfPub PE World Map's matched record ('El-Koraimet, Egypt -> Beni Suef, Egypt', dia=32in [MATCHES], len_km=19 [CONFLICTS, GEM=30km, delta 37%], start_year=2007 [GEM=2009]) corroborates diameter and endpoints but disagrees materially on length and start year; as a single Tier-2 source it does not outweigh the specific, named, contemporaneous primary-press description that matches GEM exactly, but the divergence should be recorded, not silently dropped. Net: data as entered is correct and well-supported; flagging spec tier as medium (not high) because true second-source independent corroboration of the 30km/32in figure specifically is still missing, and documenting the GulfPub length/date variance for the record.

Same AMY article names both endpoints verbatim ('الكريمات' / Al-Kurimat and 'محافظة بني سويف' / Beni Suef governorate) for this exact phase. Al-Kurimat itself sits in Giza governorate (near the Kuraymat power station on the Nile's west bank), consistent with GEM's StartState/Province=Giza; Beni Suef is its own governorate, consistent with EndState/Province=Beni Suef.

routes.corridor_desc: Short (~30km) leg of the Dahshour-Aswan South Valley/Upper Egypt trunk, running south along the Nile Valley from the El-Kuraymat offtake/compressor area (Giza governorate, ~90km south of Cairo, on the west bank near the Kuraymat power stations) to Beni Suef city/governorate. No published pipe alignment (route inside the valley - east or west bank, or crossing - is not stated by any source found); corridor bound is tight given the short distance and the fixed named endpoints, but the alignment itself is unsourced beyond 'follows the Nile Valley corridor between these two points'.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints are directly named in the cited source (Al-Kurimat, Beni Suef governorate) with an exact matching length (30km) - strong endpoint confidence. Coordinates given are the well-known town/city centroids (El-Kuraymat ~29.27N/31.25E near the Kuraymat power complex; Beni Suef city ~29.07N/31.10E), not surveyed pipe coordinates - used only to anchor a corridor suggestion, consistent with the same coordinates used on the sibling whole-line row P0477's route waypoints. No coordinate fabricated for any unnamed point; suggested accuracy capped at 'medium' because the actual pipe alignment within the valley is not sourced, only the two endpoints and total length.

summary: P6698 (Al Kurimat-Beni Suef, 30km/32in/operating/2009) is real, correctly classified, and its length/diameter/endpoints are confirmed verbatim by the sheet's own Al-Masry Al-Youm citation (medium tier, single strong source; GulfPub's conflicting 19km/2007 noted, not adopted); flagged as a duplicate leg of whole-line aggregate row P0477; owner EGAS confirmed, light operator/owner role caveat re: Nile Valley Gas Co = TAQA Gas subsidiary; Length/Location refs filled; route corridor suggested at medium accuracy (endpoints strong, alignment unsourced).
